rows.00:021c:
When the six saw who {f:I|I} was, they lowered their faces, as if staring at a single spot on the table.
I didn't recognize a single face.
The school is huge, so it was no surprise that there were faces I'd never seen, even in my own year.
From the atmosphere, the six gathered here all seemed to be strangers to {f:one another|one another}, too.{p}
rows.00:03cc:
For the time being, I sat down in an empty seat.
No one spoke, and the minutes crawled by in a terribly awkward silence.
I was the one who should have spoken up, but the mood made it so hard to say anything.
Everyone kept looking down, not moving a muscle.
And there was no sign at all of the seventh person who was supposed to come.
Time just kept slipping away for nothing.
Sitting like this forever wasn't going to get us anywhere.{p}
rows.00:0534:
"...Um, everyone, I know you're all busy and took the time to come, so I'd like to get started soon, if that's all right."
I took the plunge and spoke up.{p}
rows.00:05bc:
"I heard seven people would be gathering. Are you the seventh?
Or are you the one from the newspaper club who's going to hear our stories?"
One of them muttered it with his head still bowed, turning only his eyes toward me.
What a gloomy-looking person.
Just having him look at me sent a chill down my spine.{p}
rows.00:06c8:
"Yes. I'm {b} {a}, from the newspaper club.
Hino, one of my seniors, asked me to hear all your stories today.
Thank you for doing this."
When I answered, everyone nodded in silence.
After that, no one would say another word.{p}
rows.00:07a0:
"...Um, what do you think?
There's no point waiting like this, so shall we get started?"
I'd run out of patience, so I asked once more.
"Fine by me."
One of them said it, and the others slowly nodded.{p}
rows.00:0880:
{f:I wondered|I wondered} what kind of scary stories they were going to tell me.
{f:Was I the only one|Was I the only one} who felt that the air in the club room was strangely heavy, as if it were pressing down on my shoulders?
A lukewarm draft leaking in through the badly fitted window licked at {f:my|my} cheek.
I couldn't shake the feeling that something nameless and sinister was here, waiting for something to happen.{p}
rows.00:0a04:
There was something here that filled me with an indescribable fear.
Why?
Why would I think something like that?
Even breathing felt like a struggle.
I had never felt like this before.
As if to cut those thoughts off, I spoke up in a loud voice.
"Well then, let's begin."{p}
